title: Blueberry Galette of Shanghai
description: A fusion of Chinese pastry-making with Western fruit desserts, this sweet treat combines the delicate flaky crust with the tangy sweetness of fresh blueberries.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together the blueberries, granulated sugar, and cornstarch.
Pour the blueberry mixture onto one half of the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Fold the other half of the pastry dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with the melted butter and beaten egg.
Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar and vanilla extract.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
